enabled.description: Register the image scrambler (default true). Its enforce/audit/off mode is the mediator's stages["egress-image-scrambler"] entry (default audit).

colorSpace.description: Basis for the bit-depth requantization (default rgb). cmyk gives the same bit defense at slightly more visible change.

colorSpaceRoundtrip.description: Deprecated alias for colorSpace: true means cmyk, false means rgb. Refused if it conflicts with colorSpace.

depthLevels.description: Levels per color and alpha channel (default 64 = 6 bits, which destroys bit-0 and bit-1 stego at a change of at most 2/255; range 2-64, since more levels keep low-order stego bits).

luminanceBuckets.description: Snap each image mean brightness to one of this many levels, bounding that channel to log2(buckets) bits per image (default 8 = 3 bits; range 2-8).
